lead.en: Field statistics use first-publication dates through 30 September 2026; the map was frozen on 24 October 2026. This release does not update.

note.en: The ranking denominator (3,436) and the content denominator (3,437) differ by one work whose year-only placeholder date was replaced by its arXiv first version (25 June 2026). Historical maps are retrospective reconstructions: some reference lists come from later paper versions.
